summary.text: Jonathan Stone is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Sullivan 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Stone previously represented Sullivan 8 from December 2022 to December 2024 and works in law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Stone, also known as Jon, was born in Claremont, New Hampshire.

His career experience includes working for the Sullivan County Department of Corrections, the State of New Hampshire judicial branch, the Claremont police department and the Vermont Department of Corrections.
Stone has volunteered with the Vermont State Employees Association and AFSCME Local 3657.
Stone assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022, and left office on December 4, 2024.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee.
